create_pycolab_environment: create a PycolabEnvironment instance wrapping a key_to_door or active_visual_match game with configurable rewards
reset_episode: reset the PycolabEnvironment to start a new episode and get the initial observation and reward
step_action: step the PycolabEnvironment by taking an action and return the observation and reward
get_observation_shape: get the observation shape property from a PycolabEnvironment instance for HWC uint8 images
get_last_phase_reward: get the last phase chapter reward from the current episode in a PycolabEnvironment
